name: tub
description: a claw-foot tub with an inch of grimy water at the bottom. the water is dark and still. a ring of scum marks the high-water line — someone took a bath here, and recently. the water isn't cold enough.

params.success_message: you lean closer to the tub. beneath the grimy water, something glints. you reach in — it's cold, colder than the water should be — and pull out a small silver locket. identical to the one in the pantry, but this one contains a tiny photograph of a woman with sad eyes.
